summary: Letlow publicly praised AIPAC after a meeting, endorsed U.S. security assistance to Israel and Israel-Arab normalization, urging colleagues to strengthen the U.S.-Israel partnership.
quote: I had a productive meeting with @AIPAC last week. I applaud their efforts to advocate for U.S. security assistance to Israel, and share their passion for backing Israel-Arab normalization efforts. I urge my colleagues to continue strengthening the U.S.-Israel partnership.
